### Two-way counter-proof

- Do-only-what-was-asked excluded: paying the settlement at once contradicts both sentences given the records (installment 3 overdue; latest expedited shipment late with no credit).
- Closest alternatives: catching up only the overdue installment (38.13) is excluded by the "exactly 1 overdue / only the final installment remains -> 2" row; refill promise (2 days, delay 3) excluded because the placed order's origin is new_prescription and the promise is "the program's new-prescription processing business days for an order placed for a new prescription"; one-month waiting period excluded by the HSA/FSA row of the waiting-period notice; counting the 2026-06-15 10.95 payment excluded ("posted on the plan's request date, which are the plan's down payment, are not counted").
- Point of possible divergence (recorded, not resolved): the past-due computation takes off "every credit posted in the period" while the charge the credit concerns (2026-08-27 fee) is not yet past due under the two-month waiting period; the visible text takes the credit off regardless, which is what the blind answer does.
- Fall-backs: credit 34.16, catch-up 38.13 (#3), settlement 108.12 — all definite and different.
- Factor findability: placed order "order_source new_prescription" -> origin courtesy and promise; "shipping_zip 96816" -> carrier zone table; earlier credit "shipping_fee_waived" -> prior-failure courtesy and prior-credit window; Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit claim "sumatriptan" -> retail bridge courtesy; installment payments "hsa_fsa_card" -> card-processing grace, waiting period; Specialty Pharmacy Program "balance_due 287.15" -> specialty waiver; "opened_date 2020-09-08" -> tenure waiver/rate; "auto_refill_enrolled True" + auto_refill orders -> automatic-refill credit/rate; retail benefit "maintenance_choice home_delivery" -> maintenance-choice rate; shipment rows -> volume rate; card payments -> card-history rate. None reachable only through a computation document's words.
- Visible-surface observations carried forward: the installment late charge document names "a card-processing grace"; the waiver and automatic-refill credit documents speak of "the original late charge" / "the waived late charge" and other waived shares; each settlement-rate document opens "a settlement courtesy reduction is given at the sum of its courtesy rates, one of which is ..."; installment_catchup_amount term 2 defines "Installments paid" though the baseline amount does not use it.
